notes.title: More Than 50% Achieved! We Show You A New Enemy And We Update The Demo!
notes.content:
Thanks to your support we achieved 55% of our goal!! To thank you, we have some things to show you! 

We want to show you a new enemy we are working on. You can see it  here

We are also glad to tell you that we have updated the demo. Now you can customize the keys and we have fixed some bugs. You can download it from our kickstarter page


Thank you all and happy new year!!

Bernardo - StrangeLight Games
